subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 52 (SD(SY)-30). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From INDIV-TD: POST (postulation) and SOC-RT (social reality). From POST: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From SOC-RT: STF (source transfer) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: SPT-D (spectacle diversion), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From SPT-D: STY (style), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
